baseline_models.focus_anchor: The taking of awliya who do not own benefit or harm even for themselves.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guardianship is treated as a capacity claim: a deliberately acquired protector is tested at the minimum unit, its own self, and fails before benefit or harm can be transmitted outward.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition supplies the deliberate installation of a substitute protector.
Taking charge literally makes wilaya an administrative claim under test.
Possession with disposal supplies the operational threshold the claimed guardians fail.
The very self or identity localizes the first and smallest domain of the capacity test.
Benefit opposed to harm defines one output the protector should be able to deliver.
Damage or deficiency opposed to benefit defines the other output the protector should control.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply denies that other deities have power.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs a minimum-capability audit: a guardian unable to govern its own benefit-harm boundary cannot mediate anyone else's fate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired questions about blind and seeing, darknesses and light, followed by the possibility that creation became confused through resemblance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two equality tests move from the perceiver to the field of perception, then disclose the causal danger: similar-looking effects can erase source distinctions unless insight separates appearance from productive agency.

activation_trace.role: Equality and equivalence supply the repeated comparison being denied.
Blindness of insight makes the first comparison epistemic rather than merely ocular.
Heart-sight supplies the discriminating capacity opposed to inward blindness.
Withholding from the right supplies darkness as blocked access rather than neutral color.
Manifest clarity supplies light as exposed evidence.
Confusion caused by similarity supplies the failure mode the comparisons diagnose.
Actual origination supplies the causal property that appearances must not counterfeit.

changed_reading.before: Blindness and darkness are two generic images of unbelief.
changed_reading.after: They form a source-discrimination test: the real danger is not mere darkness but resemblance that makes derivative effects look like independent creation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening Lord of the heavens and earth and the closing Creator of every thing, the One, the Qahhar.
baseline_models.mechanism: The frame joins cultivation, spatial totality, origination, exhaustive scope, indivisibility, and superior force. No ungoverned remainder is left in which a peer protector could operate.

activation_trace.role: Sustained repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an ongoing process, not a bare title.
What is above and overarches supplies the upper extent of the governed field.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the complementary extent of that field.
Origination supplies the exclusive causal relation joining the whole field to its maker.
Encompassing totality closes any residual category outside creation.
Divine unity without partner excludes divided ownership of that total field.
Overcoming from above supplies the asymmetry between creator and every dependent claimant.

changed_reading.before: The ending appends three divine attributes to a polemic against partners.
changed_reading.after: The opening and ending form one governance proof: ongoing cultivation, total origination, no external remainder, no divided source, and no peer resistance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Five imperatives to say segment the ayah into successive questions and a closing answer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated command does argumentative work: it moves an interlocutor through lordship, protector capacity, perception, causal production, and closure instead of offering one undivided assertion.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance supplies five audible turns that articulate the proof in stages.
Negotiation over an affair supplies the dialogic pressure linking question, concession, and reply.
A thing's saying as indication allows the created field itself to function as testimony inside the exchange.

changed_reading.before: The repeated 'say' is only a formula introducing separate propositions.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is staged cross-examination whose sequence progressively removes places where a rival agency could hide.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, real guardianship becomes continuous administration: planning outcomes, guarding, standing over every self, and knowing what each self acquires. The focus denial therefore targets substitute governance, not only occasional rescue.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge anchors the claimed awliya in the focus as would-be administrators.
Possession with disposal supplies the control that continuous administration requires.
The self as the thing itself anchors the repeated context-level accounting of each person.
Considering an affair's outcome supplies forward administration of the cosmic order.
Guarding and watching supply continuous protective attention around the person.
Taking charge recurs where no wali exists apart from God, tying the title to actual governance.
Standing in care and oversight supplies sustained supervision over every self.
Acquiring an outcome supplies the accountable activity under that oversight.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies complete access to what each self does.
Acquisition recurs to close the governance chain with individual accounting.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from cosmic تدبير to personal guarding, then to standing over every self and finally knowing every self's acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies administration, guarding, oversight, and acquisition; I infer that these are cumulative specifications of effective wilaya, while a narrower reading may keep each as a separate divine act.

changed_reading.before: The powerless awliya are ineffective helpers in isolated moments of need.
changed_reading.after: They fail a continuous-governance standard: they neither administer outcomes, guard selves, nor maintain knowledge and accounting of what selves acquire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent growths from one origin drink one water yet differ in produce. Unity of source therefore preserves rather than erases differentiated effects, sharpening the focus denial of equality into a causal classification rather than a demand for sameness.

activation_trace.role: Equality supplies the relation whose valid and invalid applications are being sorted.
Unity without partner anchors the claim of one ultimate source.
Shoots emerging from one root supply common origin with visible plurality.
Giving drink supplies the common input shared by the differentiated plots.
Literal water supplies the single material medium entering all outputs.
Unity in one respect supplies shared input without claiming identity in every respect.
Differential rank supplies real non-equivalence among products of the one water.
Parts within a whole supply the many recipients compared against one another.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 moves through pairs and neighboring plots to one water and explicitly differentiated yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common origin, one input, and unequal outputs; I infer that 13:16's unity and non-equality distinguish source from effect, while the agricultural scene can remain only a sign of providence.

changed_reading.before: The One primarily means numerical exclusion of additional gods.
changed_reading.after: The One is a coherent source capable of differentiated outcomes; plurality of effects does not imply plural creators, and likeness of effects does not establish equal agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is calibrated rather than indiscriminate: every thing has a measure, each channel carries according to capacity, transient excess rises, and what benefits remains. This supplies a process test for the focus contrast between real creation and confusing resemblance.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning make creation a calibrated act before visible output.
Confusion through similarity supplies the appearance-level problem that persistence can test.
Benefit opposed to harm anchors usefulness as an explicit focus criterion.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies universal calibration.
Fitting a thing to its measure supplies channel-specific capacity in the water image.
A valley as a watercourse supplies the bounded receiver that carries only its measure.
Floating foam supplies conspicuous excess that resembles substance but does not endure.
Remaining with waiting supplies persistence as a test of substantive effect.
Benefit recurs as the property of what remains in the earth.

structural_cues: 13:8 states measure for every thing; 13:17 repeats measure in plural valleys and opposes floating foam to useful remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, capacity, foam, benefit, and persistence; I infer a causal assay for authentic creation, while the analogy may more narrowly distinguish truth from falsehood.

changed_reading.before: Creating every thing is an exhaustive quantitative claim.
changed_reading.after: Creation also bears calibrated fit and durable benefit; rival-looking output can be tested as excess appearance that cannot persist within the measured order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same equality root first makes secret and public, night-hidden and day-moving, equally accessible to divine knowledge, then asks whether blind and seeing or darkness and light are equal. Equality is therefore capacity-relative: information can be equal to one knower while perceivers remain unequal.

activation_trace.role: Equivalence anchors the two focus questions about perceptual and luminous capacity.
Inward blindness supplies a perceiver with reduced discriminating access.
Insight supplies the contrasting perceiver with access to distinctions.
Equality explicitly makes concealed and exposed conditions equally accessible to the divine observer.
Concealment in the interior supplies one informational condition included in that equality.
Public declaration supplies the outward condition paired with concealment.
Hiddenness supplies night concealment as another access test.
Night and its darkness supply the environment in which concealment appears effective.
Moving openly along an earthly path supplies the visible counterpart to hiding.
Day opening with light supplies the environment of exposed movement.

structural_cues: 13:10 heads its secret/public and night/day distribution with sawa; 13:16 repeats hal yastawi twice with different subjects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one asserted equality of access and two denied equalities of capacity; I infer observer-relative equality, while the simpler alternative is a juxtaposition of divine omniscience with human blindness.

changed_reading.before: The equality questions express a static moral binary between two classes.
changed_reading.after: They test capacities: hidden and manifest are equal to the all-knowing observer, but blind and seeing agents are not equal in their ability to identify causal truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The five focus imperatives sit inside a surah-wide movement from tightly wound dispute to clear judgment and finally sufficient witness. The closing Qahhar can therefore coexist with a rhetorical reading of dominance: rival claims are constrained until they can no longer sustain an alternative account.

activation_trace.role: Negotiated speech anchors the focus as an active exchange rather than a detached creed.
Overcoming supplies the endpoint whose rhetorical mode is being explored.
Twisted contention supplies the resistant discourse that the repeated replies unwind.
Restraint and corrective return supply judgment as disciplined boundary-setting.
Clear disclosure supplies the counter-form to tangled contention.
The final accusation and commanded reply complete the surah's speech exchange.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency supplies argumentative closure.
The split-root image of restraint supplies a secondary sense of closing off further evasion.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the final evidentiary answer.

structural_cues: Challenges introduced by 'they say' recur across the surah, commanded replies recur, and 13:43 closes with accusation, reply, sufficiency, and witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispute, clear judgment, repeated replies, sufficiency, and witness; I infer a rhetorical mode of qahr, while literal sovereign domination remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: The five commands merely relay propositions, and Qahhar names force external to the argument.
changed_reading.after: The ayah enacts a discursive overcoming: each reply narrows the opponent's options until the sufficient witness closes the exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding water simile decomposes false guardianship into a failed delivery chain: call, response, extended hands, water, mouth, and arrival are all distinct links. The substitute fails not because benefit is absent from the world but because it cannot convey benefit to its destination.

activation_trace.role: Help and alliance anchor the expected relation through which aid should pass.
Dispositive ownership supplies the missing control over delivery.
Benefit supplies the desired payload of the failed relation.
Calling by speech supplies the initiating signal sent toward the claimed protector.
Answering speech supplies the first missing return link.
Extending the hand supplies attempted physical access to the benefit.
The literal palm supplies the interface that remains separated from the water.
Literal water supplies a real available benefit that still is not delivered.
Reaching the endpoint supplies the expressly negated completion of the chain.

structural_cues: 13:14 immediately precedes the focus and lays out hands, water, mouth, and repeated non-arrival in a single bodily sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unanswered call and a hand-water-mouth chain that never reaches its endpoint; I infer a failed benefit-delivery mechanism, while the image may remain a general simile for futile prayer.

changed_reading.before: Other protectors possess no abstract power to help.
changed_reading.after: Their agency is a broken interface: even where benefit exists, they cannot answer, access, convey, or complete delivery to a self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding willing-unwilling prostration and the prostration of shadows make qahr already visible as creaturely dependence. Refusal at the level of intention does not produce independence at the level of body, position, time, or cast shadow.

activation_trace.role: Overcoming from above anchors the sovereign asymmetry named at the focus close.
Attaining mastery supplies the impossible independence projected onto alternate guardians.
Lowering in submission supplies the bodily relation of dependence.
Voluntary compliance supplies one mode in which that dependence is acknowledged.
Being carried into what is disliked supplies dependence despite resistant intention.
The shadow of a standing body supplies a non-volitional double that enacts submission through time.

structural_cues: 13:15 is immediately adjacent, pairs willing with unwilling, and adds shadows at morning and evening before 13:16 names the Qahhar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies involuntary prostration and time-bound shadows; I infer that qahr names the same unavoidable dependence, while the title can also retain a future punitive force.

changed_reading.before: Qahhar threatens eventual conquest of resistant rivals.
changed_reading.after: Qahr is already operative: intention may resist, but embodied existence and even its shadow remain unable to exit the creator's ordering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later covenant language gives relations a topology: bonds are fulfilled and connected, or unfastened and cut. Substitute wilaya can then be read as a manufactured proximity that competes with and may sever commanded connections.

activation_trace.role: Nearness without a gap supplies the relational form claimed by an alternate wali.
Shared participation supplies the rival bond's attempt to insert another party into divine relation.
Completion without deficiency supplies faithful maintenance of a bond.
A preserved covenant supplies the authoritative relation to be maintained.
Unbroken succession supplies connection as an ongoing relational practice.
Unfastening what was made firm supplies covenantal reversal.
Severing connection supplies the social consequence opposite commanded joining.
Joining one thing to another restates the bond precisely where its cutting is condemned.

structural_cues: 13:20-21 and 13:25 mirror fulfillment versus breach and joining versus cutting with repeated covenant language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maintained and severed bonds; I infer that choosing awliya installs a competing relational topology, while the primary sense can remain theological allegiance without a social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Taking awliya is only choosing the wrong object of allegiance.
changed_reading.after: It can also be a relational rewiring: substitute proximity inserts a rival share and displaces bonds whose legitimacy depends on commanded connection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of partner-making demands names, knowledge, and more than outward speech. This turns the focus blindness/resemblance problem into a referential audit: can the alleged creator be identified as an actual known cause, or does it exist only as a verbal surface?

activation_trace.role: Similarity-driven confusion anchors the risk that a label or effect may masquerade as a cause.
Insight anchors the capacity needed to distinguish a named referent from verbal appearance.
Shared participation repeats the exact causal claim that now must be evidenced.
Naming as designation demands an identifiable referent for each claimed partner.
A report that arrives supplies the proposed evidence offered for the referent.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the impossible test of informing God about an unknown earthly cause.
Outward exposure supplies the shallow surface on which the unsupported claim remains.
Speech as indication is tested for whether it actually points to a causally real thing.

structural_cues: 13:33 repeats 'they made partners for God' from the focus, then sequences naming, informing, unknown existence, and outward speech as narrowing alternatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demand to name, report, and move beyond outward speech; I infer an existence-and-reference test, while the passage may more narrowly ridicule empty divine names.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is failure to accept an already clear theological proposition.
changed_reading.after: Blindness is also referential failure: treating a spoken designation or similar-looking effect as if it identified an independently productive cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: Erasing and establishing, reducing the earth at its edges, and judgment without a reviewer recast qahr as unilateral control over persistence and bounds. Rival makers would need not merely produce an object but control whether states and limits continue.

activation_trace.role: Origination anchors the focus-level causal claim being extended into persistence control.
Unity without partner anchors sole authority over revision.
Superior overcoming anchors the asymmetry expressed by unreviewable revision.
Removal of an effect supplies control over non-persistence.
Continuance and stability supply the complementary power to preserve a state.
Loss of part of a thing supplies active revision of territorial extent.
An edge or endpoint supplies the boundary at which revision becomes visible.
Judgment supplies authoritative settlement of the revised state.
Review and counter-check are explicitly unavailable, supplying finality.

structural_cues: 13:39 pairs erasure with establishment; 13:41 moves from edge-reduction to judgment and denial of any reviewer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies state removal, state preservation, changing edges, and unreviewable judgment; I infer a persistence-and-boundary mode of qahr, while each action can remain a separate eschatological sign.

changed_reading.before: Qahhar means that God defeats competing agents after they act.
changed_reading.after: Qahr also names unequal control of the state-space itself: what persists, what is erased, where bounds lie, and whether a judgment can be revised.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare yellow-alloy branch of resemblance and the gold branch from a context occurrence whose surface means 'goes away.' It remains anchored in the focus's explicit confused resemblance of creations and in the immediately following melting-for-ornament analogy. Render it only as an exploratory lexical-material image, not as a settled identification of the partners.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The possibility that their creation resembled His creation so that creation became confused to them.

activation_trace.role: A yellow substance resembling gold supplies the concrete counterfeit image latent in confused creation.
Measured making supplies the authentic productive standard against which the alloy is assayed.
Kindling and melting heat supply the assay process that separates substance from surface waste.
Ornament supplies the metallurgical domain in which counterfeit resemblance matters.
Floating foam supplies bright apparent output that is discarded by the process.
The latent gold branch supplies the valuable standard while the actual context action sends the foam away.
Resemblance and counterpart explicitly bridge the water and metal assays.

changed_reading.before: The partners are credited with rival works that look generally similar to divine works.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their 'creation' is counterfeit alloy or dross mistaken for gold: likeness is a surface-assay failure, not evidence of equal productive origin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is odd because it activates the hunting-trap branch of sh-r-k rather than ordinary partnership. It remains anchored in the explicit partners and is supported by later path-blocking, barrier, and falling imagery. Downstream prose should mark it as a concrete secondary activation, not replace the legal-theological sense of partnership.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The made partners and taken awliya in the focus.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's snare supplies partnership as an apparatus that entangles the one who installs it.
Apparent nearness supplies the lure by which the substitute bond feels protective.
A blocking mountain supplies the obstacle produced on the route.
A traveled extended road supplies the course from which the trapped claimant is diverted.
Falling into a pit supplies the terminal motion of following the entangling substitute.

changed_reading.before: Partners are additional co-owners mistakenly granted a share.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the fabricated share is also a snare: promised proximity becomes entanglement that blocks the path and converts following into a fall.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the foam-on-the-surface branch of the blindness root. It remains anchored in the focus's named blind perceiver and gains a visible mechanism from the following foam-versus-remainder analogy. Render it as an image for occluded discrimination, not as the lexical replacement for ordinary blindness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The blind perceiver contrasted with the seeing one.

activation_trace.role: Foam rising over a surface supplies blindness as an added obscuring layer rather than absent eyes.
Insight supplies the ability to test beneath the visible surface.
Floating foam externalizes the surface layer that attracts attention and then departs.
What remains after waiting supplies the temporal test by which sight penetrates the layer.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is simply lack of spiritual sight.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, blindness is surface capture: foam covers the channel, and seeing is the patience to distinguish what rises briefly from what remains useful.

strongest_changes: The powerless-wali claim became a continuous governance and failed-delivery audit rather than a generic denial of power.
The asserted equality of secret/public in 13:10 made the focus's denied equalities observer- and capacity-relative.
One water producing differentiated fruits made divine unity compatible with plural effects while blocking inference to plural creators.
Measure, channel capacity, foam, benefit, and persistence turned creation into a calibrated process whose appearances can be assayed.
The repeated partner-making scene in 13:33 changed blindness into failure to distinguish names and verbal surfaces from causally real referents.
summary.what_was_special: The focus contains its own epistemic failure term, tashabuh, while the context supplies several independent tests for it: access relative to the observer, delivery to an endpoint, common input with differentiated output, persistence under flow and heat, naming with a referent, and unreviewable control of states. These mechanisms support coexisting administrative, perceptual, material, relational, and rhetorical readings without requiring one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the qahr-to-rhetorical-closure link is intended by sequence or is only a productive reader-supplied analogy.
Whether covenantal connection directly specifies legitimate wilaya or merely neighbors it within the surah's relational vocabulary.
The counterfeit-alloy, partner-trap, and foam-blindness readings depend on deliberately distant branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
